summary: Nora can now take custody of Discord photo, video and voice attachments, not just stickers, so `media_fetch` can describe a real Discord photo the way it already could on Signal.
details: DiscordMediaSource fetches an attachment's own CDN URL, allowlisted to Discord's own hosts before it is followed.
Every attachment type is fetched, matching how Signal already behaves — non-image bytes are stored but not yet interpreted, the same as on Signal today.
The size ceiling now matches Signal's (100 MiB) instead of the sticker-sized 2 MiB default.
limitations: The retention gap already accepted for Signal's stored photos (no separate sweep for described images) now applies to Discord attachments too — not newly introduced, but wider.
